description: Futibatinib is recommended, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for treating locally advanced or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma with a fibroblast growth factor receptor 2 (FGFR2) fusion or rearrangement that has progressed after at least 1 line of systemic treatment in adults. Futibatinib is only recommended if the company provides it according to the commercial arrangement.
